task: Spec 118 T030/T034 US2 preliminary matched fan-in evaluation and decision
environment: macOS 14.2.1 arm64; native benchmark_engine Release, --csd mode, 7 paired seeded trials, 1024 warmup + 4096 measured cycles, 44.1 kHz/ksmps32, 128 sources into 8 buses

syntheticWorkloads.note: Test-only candidate CSDs isolating pure fan-in accumulation (immediate += baseline vs sum/mac/vincr forms); NOT generated BlueMixer CSD and NOT acceptance evidence. Sources live inside the benchmark instrument; mac uses the fresh-assignment form (even argument count) with per-contribution k-rate gains.

decision: DEFER all three candidates. No production emitter change (T031/T032/T033 each resolved as documented deferral per their task text).
rationale: sum/mac upside exists only in fan-in-dominated regions with no interleaved observers (synthetic pure workloads: -11.7..-18.4%). In generated mixers, contributions to one bus interleave with every other strip's processing; any enabled effect anywhere is an opaque observer/writer requiring a full flush (eligibility contract), which eliminates the group in realistic bus-heavy projects (see barrier-rich fixture).

Weighted batching (mac) additionally requires stable per-contribution k-rate gain values; the emitter's gain scratch (kMixSendGain, ktempdb) is shared and reused per send/fader, and the contract forbids expression-name snapshots and per-host selection. Per-send scratch allocation plus replacement-output seeding (prior direct bus content counted once) plus barrier bookkeeping is the disproportionate complexity the plan rejected in favor of deferral.

No cross-platform/cross-block threshold evidence: measurements are macOS/ksmps32-only preliminary numbers; the contract requires matched small/large fan-ins across supported blocks and platforms before any static threshold. Such evidence collection cannot justify adoption while the safe regions themselves are empty in realistic projects.
vincr: -1.8..-3.9% even on pure synthetic fan-in, below realistic-mix noise, with native flag/locking semantics to verify for concurrency; fails FR-011 measured-benefit on its own.
US1 already captured the send-path savings with strictly local, barrier-free transformations.
contractQuote: If aliases/lifetimes cannot be established from generator-owned operations, emit the original accumulation immediately
affectedTests: T028 eligibility tests (16 pass, immediate path pinned); T029 observer case (23 pass); US1/US3 suites unchanged and green — no production change to re-verify.
